correctness.rationale: A pointed type at height zero is its color. At positive height it is the root color and the nonempty set of child types, of size at most b; every such set is realizable by coloring disjoint subtrees independently and repeating a type as needed. The exact-height test and the conjunction of the existential tests with the box-of-disjunction test isolate precisely each such type. All types are realized, so Boolean operations give exactly one term operation per subset of the type set, including the case r=0 (one type per height). The polynomial degree obeys d_{j+1}=1+b d_j, and the leading coefficient obeys c_{j+1}=c_j^b/b!, so the top height gives degree n and coefficient (b!)^{−(n−1)/b}, also for b=1. Equal spectra give equal polynomials on infinitely many q=2^r; at fixed n>1 the strict increase of the factorial geometric mean recovers b, then n recovers h. Checked the small height-one exponents q+q² and q+(q³+q²)/2 and the exponents 3,265,298 and 132 for the reported order-31 pair. The frozen code and recorded evidence were read, not executed; the finite evidence does not prove the unrestricted result.
